traffic.title: Traffic information
traffic.intro: Several streets will have temporary traffic changes during the Grape Harvest Festival. Here's what you need to know.

items.title: Károly Róbert Square – event tent
items.body: Tent construction starts at 8 AM on Sep 23 and covers part of the road; teardown finishes by 7 PM on Sep 28. Pék utca traffic will be diverted via Zrínyi utca, where stopping will be prohibited to keep traffic flowing.

items.title: Várkör (in front of the library) – grandstands
items.body: Grandstands will be built from 10 AM on Sep 25, temporarily narrowing this section.

items.title: Várkör – Hunyadi utca corner
items.body: This becomes a dead end, entry allowed only for residents. Guest bands' buses will park here.

items.title: Grape Harvest Parade – Sat, Sep 26
items.body: From 1 PM to approx. 4 PM, the parade moves along a route secured by about 40 barriers: Rákóczi utca – Rohonci utca – Velemi út – Rómer Flóris utca – Munkácsy utca – Kossuth utca (Fő tér) – Várkör – Károly Róbert tér. The assembly point is between the lower Gyöngyös bridge (Penny Market car park) and the Rákóczi–Rohonci junction. Only parade participants may use this route during that time.

items.title: Fő tér & Jurisics tér – street market
items.body: Access to shops and businesses may be limited on Sep 25–27 due to the market.
